The digest/output contract is algorithmic and need not change when the crate changes, but the 0.10-to-0.11 transition changes the digest-trait dependency line and must be checked against Rust 1.76 and serialized output fixtures before adoption. No sha2 candidate/MSRV evidence in the refreshed dependency-candidates.json was found in this audit; do not infer 1.76 support from Kairos Rust 1.88 usage.

If considering 0.11.0, first verify its declared MSRV and transitive digest/cpufeatures resolution with the parent 1.76 toolchain, then run CLI tests and compare input_sha256 against a known SHA-256 of exact source bytes; preserve field name, lowercase 64-character encoding, and byte-level input semantics. Do not alter JSON schema or hash canonicalization as part of the dependency bump.
